privateChange.semantics: Binary64 finite iff exponent bits are not all ones, including both NaN classes, infinities and signed zero. No public API/layout changes.

limitations: Contended shared-lease build times, not dedicated compiler throughput.
Object-file inode/hash retention is cache evidence; stable rustc exposes no complete per-query reuse report here.
Native runs compare every ordered fixture event and selected raw-bit state across builds; no new full-battle qualification.
No full-world build; generated Unit fixture is a representative small dependent crate.

dependentCguReuse.cacheSessionCaveat: Raw object list includes previous and current rustc sessions. Deduplicated normalized paths retain all17 dependent inode/hash pairs; raw total reuse counts include previous sessions and must not be interpreted as newly reused CGUs.

diskAssessment: Only the small Unit-dependent crate was built. Incremental query dep-graphs and CGU objects add storage for each crate and retained session. No safe full-world cache size can be extrapolated from this fixture; reserve several GiB and measure a bounded larger pilot before enabling across553 crates.
